info.description: The Streaming Subscription Billings API provides access to detailed billing information for streaming subscriptions. This endpoint allows users to retrieve a comprehensive list of billing records associated with their subscriptions, facilitating better management of billing data. Typical consumers of this API include application developers and finance teams who need to monitor subscription billing activities and ensure accurate financial reporting. The API supports various use cases, such as analyzing trends in subscription revenue and addressing billing inquiries.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to access detailed billing information related to your subscriptions. You can obtain charges, payment history, and other billing details for effective account management.
